ui.narration_layout:r_bdfbae5491d70cd4.text: Beasts' blood, mingling waters, the wind's path, civilization's fire, and the radiance of the sun... May the stillness of the final heaven be yours...

ui.narration_layout:r_8d057c908f9bcc46.text: Humanity accepted this vast spacetime catastrophe, and a new order arose in the new world. Earth and the displaced colonies united under the Earth Federation. In just a few months, people's lives returned to the peace they had known before the Neo Spacequake.

ui.narration_layout:r_4077623401359edb.text: Three months after the Neo Spacequake... As plots and truths hidden in the new world's chaos began to stir, the prelude to a battle that would shake spacetime was about to begin...
